thread:
Maria Chen: Hey team — dropped the latest launch post draft here: https://drive.redwood/example/launch-draft-v7
Samir Patel: Thanks — quick pass now. Two asks: (1) we need a tighter benchmark claim, (2) CTA + UTMs for webinar signups. :eyes:
Oliver K: +1 on tightening claims. Can we move from "~2x cost savings" to specific workload numbers? e.g., "reduces per-token cost by up to 48% on embed-heavy queries" — sourced from benchmark run 2026-03-18.
Maria Chen: Good call. Oliver, can you drop the exact stat? we'll call it out in the hero and the bench section.
Oliver K: Pasted from the run: ```Benchmark summary (p50 latency, cost/unit): workload=docs-embed-search, model=mosaic-13b, batch=8 => cost reduction 48% vs baseline; p50 latency 92ms```
Jen Ramos: Legal flagged a mild wording tweak: change "guarantees" to "aims to" in the customer outcomes paragraph. I'll add the exact redline.
Samir Patel: For UTMs, use campaign=launch-may2026, source=blog, medium=organic, content=hero-cta. Example: `?utm_campaign=launch-may2026&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_content=hero-cta`
Maria Chen: Perfect. Also need routing for inbound leads: prefer webinar registrants to go to SDR queue A (EMEA) for first 72 hours, then fall back to SDR pool general.
Jen Ramos: I'll coordinate with ops to update the webhook mapping in HubSpot. @PlatformBot can we get a quick sanity check on the webhook payload?
PlatformBot: webhook check OK — example payload validated. field: `lead_source: blog`, `utm_campaign: launch-may2026`, `region_hint` present when available.
Samir Patel: Small copy nit: hero CTA should read "See benchmarks & sign up" instead of "Try Redwood" — keeps expectations clear for enterprise buyers.
Maria Chen: Updated draft link with these changes. https://drive.redwood/example/launch-draft-v8 — thanks all. Can anyone do a final read by EOD? :rocket:
Oliver K: I can do a final read at 3pm PT.
Jen Ramos: Legal will sign off by 5pm PT.
Samir Patel: I'll finalize the UTM matrix and send a tiny spreadsheet to ops.
Maria Chen: Awesome — if all green, we push to staging blog and lock assets. Leaving this thread open for final checks.
